system.name: SR3R
system.one_liner: Feed-forward 3D super-resolution that predicts high-resolution 3D Gaussian splats directly from as few as two low-resolution views with a learned cross-scene mapping.

content.variant_note: two existing-versus-ours lane pairs on top (pipeline, training objective) over an output comparison of five renders with zoom crops
content.argues: Predicting HR 3DGS directly from sparse LR views replaces per-scene optimisation and changes where the high-frequency knowledge comes from, giving sharper renders.
content.subject: Existing and proposed 3DSR pipelines and training objectives, and renders of one bedroom from ground truth and four methods with magnified crops.

lessons.what_to_learn: Show a paradigm shift with paired lanes in one box grammar, colour the boxes by role, put a red-cross against green-check property list beside them, then close with a render comparison where every column repeats the same yellow box and enlarged crop in a wedge.
lessons.suits: Method papers that replace an optimisation-based pipeline with a feed-forward one and need to show both the pipeline change and the visual quality gain.

evidence: Caption: (a) existing methods need dense views and per-scene optimisation, while the proposed method predicts HR 3DGS from as few as two LR views.
Caption: (b) the reformulation changes how 3DSR acquires high-frequency knowledge, learned across scenes instead of inherited from 2DSR models.
Introduction: SR3R is plug-and-play with any feed-forward 3DGS reconstruction backbone.

summary: SR3R reformulates 3D super-resolution as a feed-forward mapping from as few as two low-resolution views to high-resolution 3D Gaussian splats. Figure 1 has two tinted panels on top and a render comparison below. Panel (a) pairs an existing lane, dense views, per-scene self-optimisation, HR 3DGS, with a red-cross list, against SR3R's lane, sparse views, direct prediction, HR 3DGS, with a green-check list. Panel (b) contrasts training on 2DSR pseudo labels for one scene with training a mapping function, drawn as a golden funnel with the letter psi, on many scenes. The bottom band shows two input views and five bedroom renders with yellow zoom wedges to sharper crops under the Ours columns.
